phase_rows.failure_signature: The first Ruff pass over every generated Caelen Python file found the same import-layout finding in each of the ten family-current runner wrappers.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Lint generated runner outputs as well as their builder template before the immutable evidence commit.
phase_rows.title: First all-generated-Python Ruff pass found ten runner import layouts

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first exact staged-evidence validation replayed each Git blob through a separate process and crossed multiple reporting windows before reaching privacy review.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use one declared batch for multi-blob staged review and validate every header, size, delimiter, and trailing byte.
phase_rows.title: First evidence-manifest pass used slow per-file Git transport

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first x2 staged privacy scan correctly classified the active Python executable path embedded in the failed Bandit version probe as a confirmed private-path hit and stopped the evidence freeze.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Sanitize failed version-probe output before artifact materialization and keep five-class privacy scanning fail closed.
phase_rows.title: First x2 staged privacy scan blocked a local executable path

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first complete x2 staged diff-hygiene check rejected one extra terminal blank line in each of the authority-gate and transition-graph tools.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Run exact staged diff hygiene after all generated and hand-written x2 files are staged and retain every whitespace failure at zero credit.
phase_rows.title: First x2 staged diff hygiene found two terminal blank lines

phase_rows.failure_signature: After the first partial finalizer had staged its four declared validation self-files, the corrected rerun treated those exact self-files as invalid owner paths and stopped before replay.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Make lifecycle self-exclusions explicit before path validation so a justified rerun can verify an already-staged validation receipt without widening owner scope.
phase_rows.title: Second evidence-finalizer pass rejected its staged self files

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first closeout lint invocation used the bare ruff command and PowerShell reported that no matching executable, function, script, or cmdlet was available on PATH.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Probe the bounded module entry point for Python tools before relying on a global executable shim, and retain a missing-shim result at zero credit.
phase_rows.title: Bare Ruff command was absent from the closeout PowerShell path

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first python -m ruff closeout lint found three import-order findings and two long-form regular-expression flag findings across the three new closeout files.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Run the exact explicit-module lint selection before closeout generation and retain the original diagnostic receipt when mechanical fixes are required.
phase_rows.title: First explicit-module closeout lint found five mechanical findings

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first exact 98-test collection process continued beyond the 30-second tool reporting window, so that wrapper returned no collection receipt.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Treat a reporting-window expiry as inconclusive, inspect the original process before any rerun, and use a nonexecuting static count when the output channel is unavailable.
phase_rows.title: Pytest collection crossed its first reporting window

phase_rows.failure_signature: PowerShell rejected the first static test-count command because the foreach expression was piped directly, creating an empty-pipe parser error before any count was emitted.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell foreach output before piping it whenever a structured projection follows the loop.
phase_rows.title: First static test-count projection used an invalid foreach pipeline

phase_rows.failure_signature: After new retained failures changed the derived counts, the first closeout rebuild stopped because its exact-evidence guard allowed only the three source files and rejected the builder's own existing generated outputs.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Declare both bootstrap inputs and deterministic builder outputs in a closed startup allowlist before any evidence-derived rebuild is needed.
phase_rows.title: First closeout rebuild rejected its own generated files

phase_rows.failure_signature: A read-only PowerShell display wrapper passed a native command string containing NUL separators to UTF8.GetString, which expected bytes and raised a conversion error before the following plain listing succeeded.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not wrap PowerShell native-command string output in Encoding.GetString; choose either native text output or an actual byte-oriented process API.
phase_rows.title: Untracked-path display attempted an invalid string-to-byte conversion

phase_rows.failure_signature: The exact index finalizer crossed the first 30-second tool window and the wrapper printed only its empty output, discarding the returned running-session handle even though the original process later completed successfully.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: When a bounded command may yield, always surface both output and session identifier before deciding whether any rerun is needed.
phase_rows.title: First exact index finalizer output channel lost its running-session handle

phase_rows.failure_signature: After mypy passed the three closeout files, python -m pyright failed before analysis because the Python environment contains no pyright module.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Distinguish Python-module and npm-CLI entry points during version probes and invoke the installed provider explicitly.
phase_rows.title: Python-module Pyright entry point was unavailable

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first npm Pyright analysis crossed a 30-second cold-start reporting window and the wrapper failed to surface its returned session handle, leaving the result inconclusive.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Preserve session identifiers for Node-based static analyzers whose first startup can exceed the initial reporting window.
phase_rows.title: First npm Pyright cold-start wrapper lost its session handle

phase_rows.failure_signature: The cap and stale-label audit emitted all required scalar results, but its appended optional git diff stat extended past the 30-second wrapper window and the session handle was not surfaced.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Keep required scalar audits separate from potentially slow human-readable diff summaries and preserve any yielded session handle.
phase_rows.title: Cap audit wrapper outlived its final optional diff-stat presentation
